newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SHARES CLOCK UP NEW RECORDS, BANKS FORGE ON.
newsitem.headline: SHARES CLOCK UP NEW RECORDS, BANKS FORGE ON.

text.p: * Total trade 99.7 million kroons compared with 104 million
kroons on Friday.
* Index up 3.58 percent to record 346.14.
* All bank shares rose, Forekspank stood out as
gained eight kroons to 217 kroons in trade of 14.3 million
kroons after it released its group half-year results and a
higher profit estimate.
* Hansapank rose seven kroons to 198 kroons in
22.3 million kroons turnover on group first-half profits.
* Uhispank turnover 29 million kroons, up 4.90
kroons to 61.90 kroons.
A rise in all banking shares on
the Tallinn bourse on Monday helped the market clock up new
records as Forekspank and Hansapank led the way.
They were boosted by the release of half-year consolidated
results. Forekspank, who also set a higher 1997 group forecast,
gained eight kroons to 217 kroons on 14.3 million kroons trade.
A dealer said Forekspank had more potential to rise as it is
cheaper than other key banking stocks.
Hansapank rose seven kroons to 198 kroons while Hoiupank's
closing price was 200.20 kroons, 5.90 kroons higher.
Uhispank gained 4.90 kroons to 61.90 kroons, supported by
active trade on the Helsinki bourse, where it is also quoted,
dealers said.
Dealers said buying pressure was continuous as listed
companies' financial results as well as general economic
conditions were good.
Dealers said they saw the market as staying active and did
not fear a large correction as foreign investors were also now
coming to the market.
"A price correction may consist of prices remaining stable
for a while," a dealer said.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn newsroom, +372 6209 201,
reuters@reuters.ee
